definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the negative-extremum fold on the empty integer sequence.
Recursive equation defining the negative-extremum fold by applying the named negative-step helper to the head.
Base equation defining the positive-extremum fold on the empty integer sequence.
Recursive equation defining the positive-extremum fold by applying the named positive-step helper to the head.
Equation defining a negative-fold step: nonnegative inputs preserve the accumulator and negative inputs delegate to the candidate helper.
Equation defining negative-candidate selection when the prior optional accumulator is absent.
Equation defining negative-candidate selection against an existing integer accumulator by choosing the larger integer.
definitions.text:
rule #negCandidate(I, pyInt(N))
    => #if I >Int N
       #then pyInt(I)
       #else pyInt(N)
       #fi

definitions.rationale: Equation defining a positive-fold step: nonpositive inputs preserve the accumulator and positive inputs delegate to the candidate helper.
Equation defining positive-candidate selection when the prior optional accumulator is absent.
Equation defining positive-candidate selection against an existing integer accumulator by choosing the smaller integer.
definitions.text:
rule #posCandidate(I, pyInt(P))
    => #if I <Int P
       #then pyInt(I)
       #else pyInt(P)
       #fi

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named solutionProgram proof term as the exact translated program AST.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram => Module(
    FuncDef("largest_smallest_integers", Params("lst"),
      Assign(Name("largest_negative"), NoneVal)
      Assign(Name("smallest_positive"), NoneVal)
      For(Name("value"), Name("lst"),
        If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
          If(Compare(Name("largest_negative"), CmpOp("is", NoneVal)),
            Assign(Name("largest_negative"), Name("value")),
            If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp(">", Name("largest_negative"))),
              Assign(Name("largest_negative"), Name("value")),
              .Stmts)),
          .Stmts)
        If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
          If(Compare(Name("smallest_positive"), CmpOp("is", NoneVal)),
            Assign(Name("smallest_positive"), Name("value")),
            If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("<", Name("smallest_positive"))),
              Assign(Name("smallest_positive"), Name("value")),
              .Stmts)),
          .Stmts))
      Return(
        TupleExpr(Name("largest_negative"), Name("smallest_positive")))))
